definitions.explanation: A prefecture in the {関西|かんさい} region of western Japan. Its capital is {神戸|こうべ}, a major international port city.

examples.japanese: {兵庫|ひょうご}{県|けん}に{住|す}んでいる。
{兵庫|ひょうご}{出身|しゅっしん}の{友人|ゆうじん}がいる。
examples.english: I have a friend from Hyogo.

examples.japanese: {兵庫|ひょうご}{県|けん}は{南|みなみ}は{瀬戸内海|せとないかい}、{北|きた}は{日本海|にほんかい}に{面|めん}している。
examples.english: Hyogo Prefecture faces the Seto Inland Sea to the south and the Sea of Japan to the north.

notes:
Located in the {関西|かんさい} region, {兵庫|ひょうご} is one of the few prefectures that spans Japan from one coast to the other. Its capital, {神戸|こうべ}, is famous for its port, international atmosphere, and {神戸牛|こうべぎゅう} (Kobe beef).

KEY PLACES:
- {神戸|こうべ}: Kobe (capital city)
- {姫路城|ひめじじょう}: Himeji Castle, a UNESCO World Heritage site
- {淡路島|あわじしま}: Awaji Island

RELATED WORDS:
- {兵庫|ひょうご}{県|けん}: Hyogo Prefecture
- {神戸市|こうべし}: Kobe City
